data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims reserves at the opening of the year were GBP 74.985m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a net adverse movement on prior underwriting years of approximately GBP 6.246m (about 8.3% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven by adverse development on the 2016 underwriting year partially offset by a small release on 2015. No explicit gross prior-year movement note was provided; the figure above is calculated from the published gross claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: The calendar year has been benign with no major loss activity to date.

The 2018 year of account has run very favourably to date with Property Gross Earned Loss ratio at 27% and, for all other classes, loss reserve assumptions have been held at planned levels following consideration of the experience in the year.
Earned reserves are assessed to reflect the experience to date.
The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note was found. Prior-year development was calculated from the published GROSS claims development table (triangle) as described in the report (see page 63). The exact reserve movement sentence(s) describing gross prior year movement were not present; the prior_year_development_gbp_m value is therefore derived from the triangle. Original table values are presented in thousands; conversions to millions were performed and rounded to three decimals. Lob-level prior-year movements are not separately quantified in the report, so per-LOB amounts are null.
